notes: Relative workflow costs, not dollars or tokens. Nested supported calls are included in root workflow cost. Required recall uses only required cases; allowed calls contribute to precision, never recall.

grilling.positive: Consequential unresolved decisions require information or preference only the human can supply.
grilling.negative: Facts discoverable in source, docs, history or experiments; settled decisions.

domain-modeling.positive: Conflicting domain concepts, names, states or invariants block implementation.
domain-modeling.negative: Adding a field or using established business concepts without semantic uncertainty.

codebase-design.positive: Module depth, interface or seam placement is the material design problem.
codebase-design.negative: Straightforward implementation within established module boundaries.

tdd.positive: Specifying observable behaviour before implementation provides useful leverage, or the user requests test-first work.
tdd.negative: Mechanical edits, prose typos, or ritual test creation without meaningful behavioural assertions.

retro.positive: A requested retrospective or observed session friction warrants environment improvement proposals.
retro.negative: Automatic end-of-session ritual or writing down speculative lessons.

how.positive: Understanding a subsystem or ownership/runtime flow is itself the task or a material blocker.
how.negative: A quick neighbouring-file read already answers the implementation question.

why.positive: Existing rationale or historical constraints are needed to answer a question or avoid undoing a deliberate choice.
why.negative: Runtime behaviour questions, or inventing motives unsupported by evidence.

architect.positive: Evidence establishes a consequential unresolved choice between materially different system shapes.
architect.negative: Architecture mentioned; established patterns; local seam decisions; performance hypotheses before measurement.

arena.positive: Independent competing candidates materially improve a consequential non-architecture choice; normally a child of architect.
arena.negative: Multiple attempts for routine work, or a second independent arena duplicating architect.

interrogate.positive: An existing high-consequence artifact merits independent adversarial review, or explicitly requested.
interrogate.negative: Default review of every edit; no artifact yet; duplicate routine checks.

reflect.positive: Recurring durable session evidence warrants changes to existing skills, or explicitly requested.
reflect.negative: One-off lesson, ordinary completion, or automatically following every retro.

show-me-your-work.positive: Long, unattended or multi-phase work needs a reviewable decision trail, or explicitly requested.
show-me-your-work.negative: Short routine edits needing only a diff and verification result.

create-verification-skill.positive: A recurring real app verification gap warrants a reusable project-local driving skill.
create-verification-skill.negative: Existing verification already covers the changed surface, or a one-off check suffices.

maintain-verification-skill.positive: An existing verification skill/feature map has drifted or its audit is requested.
maintain-verification-skill.negative: No verification skill exists, or ordinary product changes without map drift.

writing-for-agents.positive: Authoring agent-consumed instructions or consulted as a support reference by retro.
writing-for-agents.negative: Ordinary engineering implementation or human-facing prose.
